assessment.rationale: Scheduled native primary-drying run of authored case LPN-3e77218085 (synthetic knownRp variation; simulated values, not measurements). Scheduled inputs preserved: chamber 0.1 Torr (100 mTorr output), shelf init -35 C ramping to -20 C. Drying completed: the final returned solver node at 29.829293 h shows 99.999...% dried (~100%), well inside the 3600-min (60 h) horizon. Maximum returned vial-bottom temperature -27.366 C occurs at that final node (equals the maximum returned front temperature; solver-node maximum, no continuous-maximum guarantee) and sits 22.366 C below the -5 C critical product temperature on the vial-bottom basis. Peak returned flux 0.344831 kg/h/m2 at 0.25 h; whole-batch peak derived as flux x 398 vials x 3.14 cm2 = 0.124972 m2 product area -> 0.043094 kg/h. Equipment line -0.182 + 11.7*P_Torr at the scheduled 0.1 Torr gives 0.988 kg/h whole-batch capacity; capacity margin 0.944906 kg/h (derived). Forward mode does not enforce thermal/equipment limits; no experimental outcome is implied.
